title: Overlay and blur intermediates are lossless and QR overlays render crisp at their final size
detail: The sharp renderer buffers intermediates losslessly before overlays and blur regions, so a JPEG source no longer gains an extra compression generation. QR overlays are generated at their final size and checked against the smaller of output width and height before generation, so a flat output can no longer cache an unscannable QR.

title: Render overlay layers (QR codes, badge images) onto image variants
detail: The sharp renderer composites resolved overlay layers after resize and before final encoding. Overlay bytes go through the same SVG rejection as the source image, with DoS caps on layer count, size, and QR data length enforced in assertRenderSpecBounds.
